sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, a bi-weekly podcast from the American Psychological Association.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学谈话》，这是美国心理学会推出的一档双周播客节目。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Caitlin Luna.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人凯特琳·卢纳。

sentences.en: The topic for this episode is psychologically healthy workplaces.
sentences.zh: 本期节目的主题是心理健康的工作场所。

sentences.en: We spend a significant portion of our lives at work and feeling miserable on the job can be detrimental to our mental and physical health and productivity.
sentences.zh: 我们一生中很大一部分时间都在工作，如果在工作中感到痛苦，可能会对我们的身心健康和生产力造成损害。

sentences.en: A work environment that is psychologically healthy is one that focuses on employees' health and well-being and the bottom line.
sentences.zh: 一个心理健康的工作环境，是指既关注员工的身心健康，又兼顾企业经济效益的环境。

sentences.en: To explain more about what makes a workplace psychologically healthy, our guests for this
sentences.zh: 为了更深入地解释什么是心理健康的工作场所，我们本期的嘉宾是

sentences.en: episode are Dr. David Ballard, who leads APA's Office of Applied Psychology, and Bryce Vion,
sentences.zh: 戴维·巴拉德博士，他负责美国心理学会应用心理学办公室，以及布莱斯·维恩，

sentences.en: President and CEO of Autosoft, one of the winners of our 2019 Psychologically Healthy Workplace Awards.
sentences.zh: Autosoft 公司的总裁兼首席执行官，该公司是我们 2019 年“心理健康工作场所奖”的获奖者之一。

sentences.en: Autosoft, based in Northwest Pennsylvania, is an auto dealer management system provider.
sentences.zh: Autosoft 总部位于宾夕法尼亚州西北部，是一家汽车经销商管理系统提供商。

sentences.en: Welcome, David Ballard and Mr. Vion.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你们，戴维·巴拉德博士和维恩先生。

sentences.en: Thanks, Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，凯特琳。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: First off, Dr. Ballard, can you explain what it means to be a psychologically healthy workplace?
sentences.zh: 首先，巴拉德博士，您能解释一下什么是心理健康的工作场所吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Being a psychologically healthy workplace really just means paying attention to employee well-being and organizational performance and working toward the best outcomes possible
sentences.zh: 心理健康的工作场所，其实就是指关注员工的福祉和组织绩效，并努力为所有相关人员

sentences.en: for all of the people involved.
sentences.zh: 争取最佳成果。

sentences.en: So that means employees, the organization, shareholders or owners of the organization, and even the community that an organization is embedded in.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要顾及员工、组织、股东或企业所有者，甚至是组织所在的社区。

sentences.en: And there's not one single way of doing this.
sentences.zh: 实现这一目标并没有单一的方法。

sentences.en: There's not a one-size-fits-all approach.
sentences.zh: 没有所谓的“一刀切”方案。

sentences.en: It really is about taking comprehensive steps to create this kind of healthy and productive environment.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是关于采取全面的措施，来创造这种健康且高效的环境。

sentences.en: And the types of things we see in organizations fall into some general categories.
sentences.zh: 我们在各个组织中看到的举措通常可以归纳为几个大类。

sentences.en: Employee involvement, growth and development opportunities, health and safety initiatives, work-life balance and flexibility,
sentences.zh: 员工参与、成长与发展机会、健康与安全倡议、工作与生活的平衡及灵活性，

sentences.en: employee recognition, and then good, effective two-way communication in an organization.
sentences.zh: 员工认可，以及组织内部良好、有效的双向沟通。

sentences.en: And in an environment like that, where a psychologically healthy workplace is created, it helps employees and the organization thrive.
sentences.zh: 在这样一个创造了心理健康工作场所的环境中，它有助于员工和组织共同成长。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说呢？

sentences.en: Well, it creates a supportive environment so that those benefits and perks that come into play
sentences.zh: 嗯，它创造了一个支持性的环境，使得那些投入的福利和津贴

sentences.en: help employees be at their best when they're on the job so that they can manage the competing demands in their lives.
sentences.zh: 能够帮助员工在工作中发挥出最佳状态，从而让他们能够应对生活中各种相互冲突的需求。

sentences.en: They feel recognized and rewarded for their contributions to the organization and really be engaged in the work that they're contributing to the organization to move it
sentences.zh: 他们会因为对组织的贡献而感到被认可和奖励，并真正投入到他们为推动组织

sentences.en: forward and advance its mission.
sentences.zh: 向前发展和实现使命所做的工作中。

sentences.en: And do you think by and large, organizations understand what it means to be psychologically healthy?
sentences.zh: 您认为总的来说，各组织是否理解什么是心理健康的工作场所？

sentences.en: I think increasingly they do, but there's a lot of variability.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们越来越理解了，但差异很大。

sentences.en: Some organizations are really far ahead and they've been doing this for years and others are just starting to get on board.
sentences.zh: 有些组织遥遥领先，他们多年来一直致力于此，而另一些组织才刚刚开始加入。

sentences.en: Overall, we've seen employers move from a really narrow focus on physical health to more of a wellness approach and now increasingly a focus on well-being.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我们看到雇主们已经从仅仅关注身体健康，转向了更广泛的健康理念，现在则越来越关注整体福祉。

sentences.en: So really looking at the whole person in the work environment.
sentences.zh: 也就是在工作环境中真正关注“完整的人”。

sentences.en: So they're not just focusing on health risk reduction and cost savings anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不再仅仅关注降低健康风险和节省成本。

sentences.en: They're really looking at the full value that these efforts can contribute to the organization and to the employees who work there.
sentences.zh: 他们真正着眼于这些努力能为组织和员工带来的全部价值。

sentences.en: A lot of organizations know it's the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 许多组织知道这是正确的事情。

sentences.en: They want to take care of employees and create a good environment.
sentences.zh: 他们想要照顾员工并创造一个良好的环境。

sentences.en: But employers also get that this is smart business.
sentences.zh: 但雇主们也明白，这是明智的商业行为。

sentences.en: These are good business decisions.
sentences.zh: 这些都是正确的商业决策。

sentences.en: And therefore, the more they understand the importance of it, we have to do a better job of getting out information about how you actually accomplish this.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们越了解其重要性，我们就越需要做好信息传播工作，告诉他们如何真正实现这一目标。

sentences.en: So more employers understand it, but they don't necessarily know how to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以更多的雇主理解了这一点，但他们不一定知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: And this also helps employees with employee retention.
sentences.zh: 而且这也有助于员工留任。

sentences.en: This helps productivity.
sentences.zh: 这有助于提高生产力。

sentences.en: You know, I think that's one of those things that maybe an employer, do you think they think, okay, if I'm letting people use time to exercise, are they being productive?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这可能是雇主会想的一件事，比如，如果我让员工利用时间锻炼，他们还能保持生产力吗？

sentences.en: But research shows that it does help.
sentences.zh: 但研究表明，这确实有帮助。

sentences.en: It does boost productivity.
sentences.zh: 它确实能提高生产力。

sentences.en: And when people feel connected, right, to, you know, people feel like they're supported, they feel more connected to their work.
sentences.zh: 当人们感到有联系，对吧，当人们感到被支持时，他们会觉得与工作联系更紧密。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Even in that example that you gave, there's research that shows that even when employees take
sentences.zh: 即使在你给出的那个例子中，也有研究表明，即使员工在工作日抽出

sentences.en: time out of their workday to exercise, they more than make up for that time and the gain productivity throughout the day when they do that.
sentences.zh: 时间去锻炼，当他们这样做时，他们不仅能补回那些时间，还能在一天中获得更高的生产力。

sentences.en: So yeah, overall, these kinds of efforts benefit employees, they benefit the organization.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，总的来说，这些努力对员工有益，对组织也有益。

sentences.en: You know, on the employee front, it contributes to higher levels of job satisfaction, better physical and mental health.
sentences.zh: 在员工方面，它有助于提高工作满意度，改善身心健康。

sentences.en: The morale is better in a workplace, they're more motivated, and they're better able to manage the stress that they face day to day on the job.
sentences.zh: 工作场所的士气会更好，员工更有动力，也更能应对日常工作中面临的压力。

sentences.en: But on the employer side, there are a lot of benefits as well.
sentences.zh: 但在雇主方面，也有很多好处。

sentences.en: So yes, it can help reduce problematic things like absenteeism and turnover, presenteeism where people are physically on the job,
sentences.zh: 所以是的，它可以帮助减少旷工和离职等问题，以及“出勤主义”，即人们虽然人在岗位上，

sentences.en: but they're not performing up to their full potential because they're burned out or sick.
sentences.zh: 但因为精疲力竭或生病而无法发挥全部潜力。

sentences.en: But more importantly, it improves performance and productivity.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，它提高了绩效和生产力。

sentences.en: It can improve product and service quality, customer service and satisfaction ratings, reduce accidents and injuries.
sentences.zh: 它可以提高产品和服务质量、客户服务和满意度评分，减少事故和伤害。

sentences.en: It can help an employer become an employer of choice.
sentences.zh: 它可以帮助雇主成为求职者的首选。

sentences.en: And that's really critical because if you can attract and retain the best quality workers, that gives you a competitive advantage in the marketplace.
sentences.zh: 这一点至关重要，因为如果你能吸引并留住最优秀的员工，这就会在市场上给你带来竞争优势。

sentences.en: And you do interviews in the media all the time about this very topic.
sentences.zh: 你经常在媒体上就这个话题接受采访。

sentences.en: And you've said that company culture matters the moSt. So how do those perks and incentives fit in with the larger culture?
sentences.zh: 你说过企业文化最重要。那么，这些津贴和激励措施是如何融入更大的企业文化中的呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a very important point because it's not just about the perks or the benefits or the policies or programs that an employer puts in place.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常重要的观点，因为这不仅仅是关于雇主提供的津贴、福利、政策或项目。

sentences.en: Those values have to get instilled in the actual culture of the organization.
sentences.zh: 这些价值观必须灌输到组织的实际文化中。

sentences.en: I mean, employees are smart.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，员工很聪明。

sentences.en: They know when an organization doesn't mean it and they're putting something in place to squeeze more productivity out of them.
sentences.zh: 他们知道组织何时不是真心的，只是为了从他们身上榨取更多生产力而实施某些措施。

sentences.en: And they know when employers don't really care about their well-being.
sentences.zh: 他们也知道雇主何时并不真正关心他们的福祉。

sentences.en: So it has to get embedded in the culture and the organization has to walk the talk.
sentences.zh: 所以它必须融入文化中，组织必须言行一致。

sentences.en: You can't just say that you care about it and slap some programs in place.
sentences.zh: 你不能只是口头上说关心，然后随便搞几个项目应付了事。

sentences.en: The psychosocial work environment is really critical.
sentences.zh: 心理社会工作环境真的至关重要。

sentences.en: And this is why psychology is important in the workplace because those organizational level factors, the way work
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么心理学在工作场所很重要，因为那些组织层面的因素，即工作的

sentences.en: is designed and carried out in organizations makes a huge difference.
sentences.zh: 设计和执行方式，会产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Having supportive supervisors, the level of trust that exists in an organization, whether employees feel valued for their contributions,
sentences.zh: 拥有支持性的主管，组织内部存在的信任水平，员工是否感到自己的贡献受到重视，

sentences.en: whether they're positive interpersonal relationships and civility in the interactions that occur there,
sentences.zh: 那里的人际关系是否积极，互动是否文明，

sentences.en: and whether employees are engaged in meaningful work where they feel connected to the mission of the organization and they understand their role in helping to advance that.
sentences.zh: 以及员工是否从事有意义的工作，感到与组织的使命相连，并理解他们在推动使命实现中的作用。

sentences.en: Why do you think there's been this shift?
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么会出现这种转变？

sentences.en: I mean, do you think all these wellness programs or perks and things like that, why do you think it's so important today?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为所有这些健康项目或津贴之类的东西，为什么你觉得今天如此重要？

sentences.en: Did we see this in the workplace 30, 40 years ago?
sentences.zh: 我们在 30、40 年前的工作场所看到过这种情况吗？

sentences.en: Well, a lot of these efforts have existed for a long time, but they had a much narrower focus.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很多这样的努力已经存在很长时间了，但它们关注的焦点要狭窄得多。

sentences.en: So I think it's coming from multiple angles.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是多方面因素共同作用的结果。

sentences.en: I think employers are increasingly coming to understand that creating a psychologically healthy workplace is good for employees and is good for business, too.
sentences.zh: 我认为雇主们越来越认识到，创造一个心理健康的工作场所对员工有益，对企业也有利。

sentences.en: I think there's a shift in expectation among workers who are entering the workforce that they expect to have more flexibility and to juggle the competing things they have in life.
sentences.zh: 我认为进入职场的员工期望发生了转变，他们期望有更多的灵活性，能够兼顾生活中各种相互冲突的事情。

sentences.en: They expect to have a job where they feel like they're contributing to something bigger than themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们期望拥有一份能让他们感到自己正在为比自身更宏大的事业做出贡献的工作。

sentences.en: And then even in public opinion, a lot more of this is talked about openly.
sentences.zh: 而且在公众舆论中，这些话题也被更公开地讨论。

sentences.en: So if an employer is not taking these steps, employees will go elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 所以如果雇主不采取这些措施，员工就会去别处。

sentences.en: They'll go seek out jobs somewhere else that they see as a better work environment.
sentences.zh: 他们会去寻找他们认为工作环境更好的地方工作。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What does EPA look for in award winners for the Psychologically Healthy Workplace Awards?
sentences.zh: 美国心理学会（APA）在评选“心理健康工作场所奖”时看重什么？

sentences.en: Well, the process for our award evaluation is actually quite rigorous.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们的奖项评估过程实际上非常严格。

sentences.en: So it's not just a vanity workplace award where you talk about how great you are in a short essay.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是一个虚荣的职场奖项，让你在短文中吹嘘自己有多棒。

sentences.en: And if it sounds nice, we give you an award.
sentences.zh: 如果听起来不错，我们就给你颁奖。

sentences.en: You know, as psychologists, we're held to a different standard.
sentences.zh: 你知道，作为心理学家，我们受到不同的标准约束。

sentences.en: So we really want to bring our research to bear and our assessment skills in psychology to evaluate these applicant organizations.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的希望运用我们的研究成果和心理学评估技能来评估这些申请组织。

sentences.en: So there's a multi-step process that involves collecting qualitative and quantitative information from the organizations.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一个多步骤的过程，涉及从组织收集定性和定量信息。

sentences.en: We conduct online employee surveys of the applicants.
sentences.zh: 我们对申请者进行在线员工调查。

sentences.en: We hear from employees themselves.
sentences.zh: 我们听取员工自己的意见。

sentences.en: And one of the unique things about the program is we actually go out and do site visits.
sentences.zh: 该项目的一个独特之处在于，我们实际上会进行实地考察。

sentences.en: So we tour the facility, we meet with the organization's leaders and do focus groups with employees and look for a convergence of data and from all of those sources to identify
sentences.zh: 我们会参观设施，与组织领导人会面，并与员工进行焦点小组讨论，寻找所有这些来源的数据汇合点，以确定

sentences.en: organizations that are doing this well.
sentences.zh: 那些做得很好的组织。

sentences.en: So we look for organizations that understand the importance of creating a psychologically healthy workplace and how that connects to employee well-being and the
sentences.zh: 所以我们寻找那些了解创造心理健康工作场所的重要性，以及它如何与员工福祉和

sentences.en: success and performance of the organization.
sentences.zh: 组织的成功与绩效相联系的组织。

sentences.en: And we look for organizations that are taking steps in all of those major areas I mentioned earlier, employee involvement and growth and development and so on.
sentences.zh: 我们寻找那些在我之前提到的所有主要领域采取措施的组织，比如员工参与、成长与发展等等。

sentences.en: And we also look for positive outcomes on the employee front and for the organization.
sentences.zh: 我们还寻找员工和组织层面的积极成果。

sentences.en: So we want to see that this is actually accomplishing something in the organizations.
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望看到这些措施在组织中确实取得了一些成效。

sentences.en: And then finally, we look for an ongoing commitment from organizations that creating a psychologically healthy workplace, it isn't an end state.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们寻找组织持续的承诺，即创造一个心理健康的工作场所并不是一个终点。

sentences.en: It's an ongoing process that even companies that are doing great can always work to improve things and the environment changes.
sentences.zh: 这是一个持续的过程，即使是表现出色的公司也总能努力改进，而且环境也在不断变化。

sentences.en: So it's something you have to stay on top of and continue to make strides to make it even better moving forward.
sentences.zh: 所以这是你需要时刻关注并不断努力，以使其在未来变得更好的事情。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's turn over to Autosoft for a few.
sentences.zh: 让我们转向 Autosoft 谈谈。

sentences.en: Mr. Vian, congratulations.
sentences.zh: 维恩先生，恭喜你们。

sentences.en: Your company's had a good turnaround story that happened the past few years.
sentences.zh: 你们公司在过去几年里经历了一个很好的扭亏为盈的故事。

sentences.en: Can you talk about what happened?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: When I came to Autosoft full-time, it's a family business, but I stepped out for a while.
sentences.zh: 当我全职回到 Autosoft 时，这是一家家族企业，但我离开了一段时间。

sentences.en: And when I came back, I had a vision that I wanted to take the company in a new direction because we were building new products and needed to move up market in our industry.
sentences.zh: 当我回来时，我有一个愿景，我想带领公司走向一个新的方向，因为我们正在开发新产品，需要在行业中向高端市场迈进。

sentences.en: And when I came back, I saw a culture that was missing.
sentences.zh: 当我回来时，我发现公司缺失了一种文化。

sentences.en: There wasn't a management style that really fit with how I wanted to run things.
sentences.zh: 没有一种管理风格真正符合我想要经营公司的方式。

sentences.en: And I always had a value in the mixture of feeling like there's a purpose in the work and big goals, but also just having some trust and some really excitement about the work
sentences.zh: 我一直很看重一种混合的价值观，既要有工作的目标感和宏大的目标，也要有信任感，并对我们所做的

sentences.en: that we do.
sentences.zh: 工作感到真正的兴奋。

sentences.en: And when I came back, we didn't have that here.
sentences.zh: 当我回来时，我们这里没有这些。

sentences.en: We had a lot of people who didn't understand whether they were doing a good job or not.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多员工不知道自己是否做得好。

sentences.en: We didn't have, you know, reviews or one-on-ones.
sentences.zh: 我们没有绩效评估或一对一沟通。

sentences.en: So it actually, when I first came back, it took a lot of time to build some trust because when I
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，当我刚回来时，花了很多时间来建立信任，因为当我

sentences.en: started to put in these new programs, even though these were positive programs, the first reaction was just skepticism and maybe it was something new and it was change.
sentences.zh: 开始实施这些新项目时，尽管这些是积极的项目，但最初的反应只是怀疑，也许是因为这是新事物，是变革。

sentences.en: So that's where some of this started off and it took us years to get to where we are today.
